use std::cell::UnsafeCell;
use std::sync::{Arc, Weak};
unsafe extern "C" {
    fn arc_test_dropped(sum: usize);
}
struct Payload {
    slots: [UnsafeCell<usize>; 8],
}
// SAFETY: the host gives each slot to one worker; all reads occur in the
// destructor after the last strong decrement's release/acquire synchronization.
unsafe impl Send for Payload {}
unsafe impl Sync for Payload {}
impl Drop for Payload {
    fn drop(&mut self) {
        let mut sum = 0;
        for slot in &self.slots {
            sum += unsafe { *slot.get() };
        }
        unsafe {
            arc_test_dropped(sum);
        }
    }
}
fn arc_create() -> *mut u8 {
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(Arc::new(Payload {
        slots: [
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
            UnsafeCell::new(0),
        ],
    }))) as *mut u8
}
fn arc_clone(p: *mut u8) -> *mut u8 {
    let value = unsafe { &*(p as *const Arc<Payload>) };
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(value.clone())) as *mut u8
}
fn arc_downgrade(p: *mut u8) -> *mut u8 {
    let value = unsafe { &*(p as *const Arc<Payload>) };
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(Arc::downgrade(value))) as *mut u8
}
fn weak_clone(p: *mut u8) -> *mut u8 {
    let value = unsafe { &*(p as *const Weak<Payload>) };
    Box::into_raw(Box::new(value.clone())) as *mut u8
}
fn weak_upgrade(p: *mut u8) -> *mut u8 {
    let value = unsafe { &*(p as *const Weak<Payload>) };
    match value.upgrade() {
        Some(value) => Box::into_raw(Box::new(value)) as *mut u8,
        None => std::ptr::null_mut(),
    }
}
fn arc_release(p: *mut u8) -> usize {
    drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(p as *mut Arc<Payload>) });
    1
}
fn weak_release(p: *mut u8) -> usize {
    drop(unsafe { Box::from_raw(p as *mut Weak<Payload>) });
    1
}
fn arc_write_release(p: *mut u8, slot: usize) -> usize {
    let value = unsafe { Box::from_raw(p as *mut Arc<Payload>) };
    unsafe {
        *value.slots[slot].get() = slot + 1;
    }
    drop(value);
    1
}
fn empty_weak_control() -> usize {
    let weak = Weak::<Payload>::new();
    let cloned = weak.clone();
    assert!(weak.upgrade().is_none());
    assert!(cloned.upgrade().is_none());
    1
}
fn main() {
    let empty: fn() -> usize = empty_weak_control;
    empty();
    let make: fn() -> *mut u8 = arc_create;
    let clone: fn(*mut u8) -> *mut u8 = arc_clone;
    let down: fn(*mut u8) -> *mut u8 = arc_downgrade;
    let wc: fn(*mut u8) -> *mut u8 = weak_clone;
    let up: fn(*mut u8) -> *mut u8 = weak_upgrade;
    let ar: fn(*mut u8) -> usize = arc_release;
    let wr: fn(*mut u8) -> usize = weak_release;
    let write: fn(*mut u8, usize) -> usize = arc_write_release;
    let a = make();
    let b = clone(a);
    let w = down(a);
    let w2 = wc(w);
    let c = up(w);
    ar(c);
    write(b, 0);
    ar(a);
    wr(w);
    wr(w2);
}
